import os
import sqlite3
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from src.api import handle_add, handle_import
from src.repository import initialize, list_contacts
from src.service import import_contacts


class ImportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def connection(self, isolation_level=""):
        connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:", isolation_level=isolation_level)
        self.addCleanup(connection.close)
        initialize(connection)
        handle_add(connection, {"email": "a@b", "name": "Alice"})
        return connection

    def test_counts_and_normalization(self):
        connection = self.connection()
        self.assertEqual(handle_import(connection, {"contacts": [
            {"email": " A@B ", "name": " Alice "},
            {"email": " C@D ", "name": " Carol "},
        ]}), {"inserted": 1, "updated": 1})
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(connection), [("a@b", "Alice"), ("c@d", "Carol")])
        self.assertEqual(import_contacts(connection, []), {"inserted": 0, "updated": 0})
        self.assertFalse(connection.in_transaction)

    def test_invalid_batches_do_not_write(self):
        connection = self.connection()
        invalid_rows = [None, [], "a@b", {}, {"email": "a@b"},
                        {"email": "a@b", "name": "A", "extra": 1}]
        invalid_rows += [{"email": email, "name": "A"} for email in
                         [None, 1, "", "@b", "a@", "a@@b", "a b@c", "a@b\tc"]]
        invalid_rows += [{"email": "a@b", "name": name} for name in [None, 1, "", " \t"]]
        for row in invalid_rows:
            with self.subTest(row=row), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                import_contacts(connection, [{"email": "new@b", "name": "New"}, row])
            self.assertEqual(list_contacts(connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            import_contacts(connection, [
                {"email": "A@B", "name": "A"},
                {"email": " a@b ", "name": "B"},
            ])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])

    def test_envelopes(self):
        connection = self.connection()
        for payload in [None, [], {}, {"contacts": None}, {"contacts": {}},
                        {"contacts": [], "extra": 1}, {"contacts": ""}]:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                handle_import(connection, payload)

    def test_database_failure_rolls_back(self):
        for isolation_level in ["", None]:
            connection = self.connection(isolation_level)
            connection.execute("""CREATE TRIGGER reject_contact BEFORE INSERT ON contacts
                WHEN NEW.email = 'bad@b' BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'rejected'); END""")
            with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
                import_contacts(connection, [
                    {"email": "a@b", "name": "Changed"},
                    {"email": "new@b", "name": "New"},
                    {"email": "bad@b", "name": "Bad"},
                ])
            self.assertEqual(list_contacts(connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])
            self.assertFalse(connection.in_transaction)

    def test_commit_failure_rolls_back(self):
        connection = self.connection()
        connection.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON")
        connection.execute("CREATE TABLE parent (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")
        connection.execute("""CREATE TABLE child (id INTEGER REFERENCES parent(id)
                            DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED)""")
        connection.execute("""CREATE TRIGGER invalid_reference AFTER INSERT ON contacts
                            BEGIN INSERT INTO child VALUES (1); END""")
        with self.assertRaises(sqlite3.IntegrityError):
            import_contacts(connection, [{"email": "new@b", "name": "New"}])
        self.assertEqual(list_contacts(connection), [("a@b", "Alice")])
        self.assertFalse(connection.in_transaction)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
EOF
